title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Structured Strategies: DCA, Ranges, and Hedging

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of Dollar-Cost Averaging as described in lesson 2?
options: It removes all market risk from the trade
It smooths the average entry cost by buying fixed amounts over time
It allows traders to predict exact market tops
It eliminates the need for stop-loss orders
questions.explanation: DCA averages entry cost by investing fixed amounts over time without trying to time the bottom.

questions.text: True or false: Hedging a long-term core position by opening a small short position or buying a put option can offset temporary losses if the market drops.
questions.explanation: A hedge gains value when the market falls, offsetting losses on spot holdings.
